note: Render + post. Creator-requested variation of the D bet: yellow headline instead of green, and the laptop screen becomes an icon comparison — competitor AI apps crossed out, BrainOutside glowing with a check.

post.hue_note: --hue 55 protects the yellow lettering from the darkening; the D4 run used the default 120 for green

measured.headline_contrast: 4.29:1 (yellow 226.6 on a 43.3 ground). Yellow reads at 226 luminance against green's 179 — a brighter hook for free.
measured.screen: luminance 75.9, saturation 35% -- versus 208.9 / 8% for D4's light-mode UI. The dark screen makes his face (124) brighter than the screen, fixing the hierarchy inversion that D3 and D4 both had.
measured.skin: 124.4 (D4 was 138.1) -- this plate came out slightly darker than D4's; the scrim did not cause it (plate and final both measure 124.4)

known_gaps.logo_fidelity: ChatGPT (white knot on black) and Gemini (four-point sparkle) render correctly. The middle Perplexity tile is still an invented geometric mark, not the real logo -- the model redraws logos rather than reproducing them. Fix = composite real icon PNGs, same technique as tools/composite_logo.py; the repo has no ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini assets yet.
known_gaps.message_conflict: The red X over ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini reads as 'this replaces them', which contradicts the video's own ANY AI claim and the checkstrip used on A2/C/D. The Claude-is-absent-because-it-powers-this nuance is not legible to a viewer. An honest alternative with the same visual density: checkmarks on every AI icon around a glowing BrainOutside centre -- 'one brain, every AI'.
